description: Convert PDFs and other documents to structured formats via Docling, for AI applications.
name: io.github.docling-project/docling-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Docling Serve instance. Required when conversion mode is remote.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for authenticating with Docling Serve.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in seconds for the remote Docling Serve API. Default: 300.0.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for remote API requests. Default: 3.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to fall back to local conversion when Docling Serve is unreachable.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_FALLBACK_TO_LOCAL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to retain page images in converted documents. Default: false.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_KEEP_IMAGES

environmentVariables.description: Image scale factor (e.g. 1.0, 2.0). Increase to avoid tensor batching errors. Default: 1.0.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_IMAGES_SCALE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to disable the OCR pipeline. Default: true.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_DO_OCR

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to disable table structure detection. Default: true.
environmentVariables.name: DOCLING_MCP_DO_TABLE_STRUCTURE

title: Docling MCP
